reviewType: Accepted Sunwheel Mill iPad still-image visual review
identityClarification: dev.a15832d0fd is the verification record source fingerprint, not the literal Simulator Info.plist build identifier. dev.local is the parent-confirmed literal Simulator build identifier.

testResult.source: parent report and accepted-01 tablet verification record

summary: All five restoration milestones were inspected in both iPad orientations, together with both dense 49-star boards, native-win results, and the rotation/native-input sequence.
Both layouts visibly preserve the 75%-closed to 100%-open outlet payoff. Golden light flows onward only at completion, and the outlet remains visible beside or above result UI.
The accepted living-light star material is readable in partial and dense boards. Piece outlines and silhouettes separate colors from the warm architecture, foliage and workshop details.
Mill, bridge, terraces and workshop retain rich perimeter construction. No center-clearing mask, rectangular fade boundary or cloud seam was seen.
HUD, feedback and action text remain readable with controls contained inside the viewport. Rotation stills retain the expected scores and restoration milestones.
nonBlockingObservations: Landscape trims only the extreme tip of the top vane; the wheel and stage identity remain clear.
Portrait score HUD overlaps the upper vane but both remain readable.
The lowest-left amber piece in dense portrait overlaps warm foliage while retaining a clear luminous outline.
limitations: Static original screenshots establish visual appearance at captured instants; they do not establish animation timing, motion quality or absence of transient issues between frames.
Native interaction assertions are supplied by the parent-owned 2/2 zero-skip run, not inferred solely from images.
Development Simulator evidence only; no physical-device installation or actual VoiceOver evidence is claimed.
Raw original PNG bytes and EXIF orientation were preserved; no image edits, recompression or rotation were applied.
